notes: API 21360 documents a complete application state enum, but appID and appName/namespaceID are all optional and current waiter metadata cannot require one of these identity alternatives only when polling. The list API accepts CSV appIDs, which cannot serve as a scalar identity selector. No readiness waiter is fabricated.
Change history has no change-order ID input for selecting one operation. Load-balancer healthy state is an empty string, which current waiter metadata cannot express as a terminal scalar.
